content: Tohn kahnimw Kiriad Searim eri ale Kohpwahn Inoun KAUN-O oh wahla ni imwen Apinadap, me mi pohn dohl ehu. Irail ahpw kasarawihala nah pwutak Eleasar pwe en kin apwahpwalih Kohpwahn Inowo.
Kohpwahn Inoun KAUN-O eri mihmi nan kahnimw Kiriad Searim ahnsou reirei, kereniong sounpar 20. Erein ahnsowo mehn Israel koaros ahpw kin likweriong KAUN-O pekipeki sapwellime sawas.

Samuel eri padahkihong mehn Israel ko, “Ma kumwail pahn sohpeiong KAUN-O ni mohngiongimwail unsek, eri, kumwail uhdahn pahn kesehla koht koaros en mehn liki kan oh sansal akan en koht lih Asdarde. Kumwail kasarawihong pein kumwail unsek KAUN-O, oh pwongih ihete. Eri, e ahpw pahn kapitkumwailsang pahn manaman en mehn Pilisdia kan.”
Mehn Israel ko eri kesehla dikedik kan en ar koht Paal oh Asdarde; re ahpw kin pwongih KAUN-O kelehpw.
Samuel eri ekerpene mehn Israel koaros pwe re en pokonpene Mispa. E ahpw padahkihong irail, “I pahn kapakapkin kumwail rehn KAUN-O wasao.”

Irail eri pokonpene Mispa. Re ahpw kihpene pihl oh wudekihdiong nan pwehl wiahki ar mehn meirong ong KAUN-O, re kaisihsol rahno pwon. Re ahpw nda, “Se dipadahr mwohn KAUN-O.” Samuel eri koukousoan Mispa oh kakaun mehn Israel ko.

Ni mehn Pilisdia ko ar rongada me mehn Israel ko pokonpenehr Mispa, nanmwarkien Pilisdia limmeno, iangahki sapwellimarail sounpei ko, mwesella pwe re en mahweniong irail. Ni Mehn Israel ko ar rongada met re masepwehkada;
re ahpw ndaiong Samuel, ketihtihki, “Komw dehr tokedihsang omw kasakaskin kiht rehn KAUN-O pwe en ketin doareikitasang mehn Pilisdia kan.”
Samuel eri kemehla sihmpwul men oh pwonte isikala pwe en meirongkihong KAUN-O. E ahpw peki rehn KAUN-O en ketin sewese Israel. KAUN-O eri ketin karonge eh pekipek.

Pwe nindokon Samuel eh wiewia eh meirongo, mehn Pilisdia ko tapihada mwekid en mahweno. Ahpw ni ahnsowohte, kapitien KAUN-O ahpw ngiriseksang nanleng ong pohn mehn Pilisdia ko. Re ahpw pingida oh tangdoaui.
Mehn Israel ko pwakihirailla sang Mispa, re lao lel Pedkar, kemekemeirailla kohla nanialo.
Samuel eri ale takai ehu oh kauwada nanpwungen Mispa oh Sen, e ahpw ketihtihki, “KAUN-O ketin sewesei kitail lao lel wasaht.” Eri, e ahpw kihong eden takaio “Takaien Sawas.”
Mehn Pilisdia ko eri lohdi, oh KAUN-O sohla ketin mweidohng irail en pedolong nan sapwen mehn Israel ko nindokon Samuel eh momour.

Kahnimw koaros, sang Ekron lel Kad, me mehn Pilisdia ko kalowehdi, ahpw pwurehng mehn Israel. Mehn Israel eri pwurehng ale sahpw koaros me uhdahn sapwarail. Eri, mweimwahu pil miehla nanpwungen mehn Israel oh mehn Kenan.
Samuel eri kakaun mehn Israel erein eh momour.
Nan sounpar koaros e kin ketseli oh ketila Pedel, Kilkal, oh Mispa, oh wasa pwukat koaros e kin kapwungala repenpwung kan en mehn Israel.
E ahpw kin pwurala ni imwe nan Rama, wasa e pil kin wia ie sounkopwung. E kauwadahng KAUN-O pei sarawi ehu nan Rama.
